title: Figure 39: Earth's Atmosphere, world map of density deviations from 1962 standard
description: Color world map with continents shaded and labeled (Canada, U.S., Europe, Russia, Middle East, Asia, Africa, South America, Australia, Antarctica), overlaid with a line of points from the South Pacific to northeastern Russia marked with percent deviations (-48%, -19%, 0%, +7%, +10%, +20%, +28%). Header text cites the "1962 Standard Atmosphere," "1966 Standard Atmosphere Supplement" and "1959 Selected Meridional Cross sections of the Northern Hemisphere NAVAIR-50-1C-59." Caption: "Figure 39. Earth's Atmosphere. Earth's atmosphere is not a series of concentric, constant-density shells or globally uniform..."
